CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm;

DO $$
DECLARE
    constraint_record RECORD;
BEGIN
    FOR constraint_record IN
        SELECT constraint_name
        FROM information_schema.table_constraints
        WHERE table_schema = 'public'
          AND table_name = 'human_handoff_tasks'
          AND constraint_type = 'CHECK'
    LOOP
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM pg_constraint constraint_item
            INNER JOIN pg_class relation
                ON relation.oid = constraint_item.conrelid
            WHERE relation.relname = 'human_handoff_tasks'
              AND constraint_item.conname =
                  constraint_record.constraint_name
              AND (
                    pg_get_constraintdef(
                        constraint_item.oid
                    ) ILIKE '%source_type%'

                    OR pg_get_constraintdef(
                        constraint_item.oid
                    ) ILIKE '%task_type%'
                  )
        ) THEN
            EXECUTE FORMAT(
                'ALTER TABLE human_handoff_tasks DROP CONSTRAINT %I',
                constraint_record.constraint_name
            );
        END IF;
    END LOOP;
END
$$;

ALTER TABLE human_handoff_tasks
    ADD CONSTRAINT human_handoff_tasks_source_type_check
    CHECK (
        source_type IN (
            'appointment_confirmation',
            'disruption_case',
            'waitlist_offer',
            'appointment',
            'medication_case',
            'insurance_case',
            'feedback_case',
            'knowledge_query',
            'manual'
        )
    );

ALTER TABLE human_handoff_tasks
    ADD CONSTRAINT human_handoff_tasks_task_type_check
    CHECK (
        task_type IN (
            'confirmation_no_response',
            'reschedule_request',
            'calendar_sync_issue',
            'medical_review',
            'complaint',
            'insurance_support',
            'information_request',
            'manual_followup'
        )
    );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS clinic_knowledge_entries (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    clinic_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES clinics(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    service_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES services(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    category TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (
            category IN (
                'general_info',
                'working_hours',
                'location',
                'service_info',
                'pricing',
                'insurance',
                'preparation',
                'policy',
                'faq',
                'other'
            )
        ),

    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    answer_text TEXT NOT NULL,

    keywords TEXT[] NOT NULL DEFAULT ARRAY[]::TEXT[],

    price_min NUMERIC(14, 2),
    price_max NUMERIC(14, 2),
    currency TEXT,

    requires_human_confirmation BOOLEAN
        NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    valid_from DATE,
    valid_to DATE,

    source_note TEXT,

    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'
        CHECK (
            status IN (
                'draft',
                'published',
                'archived'
            )
        ),

    created_by TEXT,
    updated_by TEXT,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CHECK (
        price_min IS NULL
        OR price_min >= 0
    ),

    CHECK (
        price_max IS NULL
        OR price_max >= 0
    ),

    CHECK (
        price_min IS NULL
        OR price_max IS NULL
        OR price_max >= price_min
    ),

    CHECK (
        valid_from IS NULL
        OR valid_to IS NULL
        OR valid_to >= valid_from
    )
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_knowledge_entries_active
    ON clinic_knowledge_entries(
        clinic_id,
        status,
        category
    );

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_knowledge_entries_title_trgm
    ON clinic_knowledge_entries
    USING GIN (
        LOWER(title) gin_trgm_ops
    );

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_knowledge_entries_answer_trgm
    ON clinic_knowledge_entries
    USING GIN (
        LOWER(answer_text) gin_trgm_ops
    );

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_knowledge_entries_keywords
    ON clinic_knowledge_entries
    USING GIN (keywords);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS clinic_information_queries (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    clinic_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES clinics(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    patient_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES patients(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    query_text TEXT NOT NULL,
    normalized_query TEXT NOT NULL,

    category_hint TEXT,

    matched_entry_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES clinic_knowledge_entries(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    match_score NUMERIC(8, 4),

    status TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (
            status IN (
                'answered',
                'escalated',
                'unanswered'
            )
        ),

    answer_text TEXT,

    source_channel TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'whatsapp'
        CHECK (
            source_channel IN (
                'whatsapp',
                'sms',
                'phone',
                'telegram',
                'web',
                'manual'
            )
        ),

    wants_human_response BOOLEAN
        NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    consent_to_contact BOOLEAN
        NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    handoff_task_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES human_handoff_tasks(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_information_queries_clinic
    ON clinic_information_queries(
        clinic_id,
        created_at DESC
    );

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_information_queries_unanswered
    ON clinic_information_queries(
        status,
        created_at DESC
    )
    WHERE status IN (
        'escalated',
        'unanswered'
    );

SELECT
    TRUE AS success,
    'migration_completed' AS result,
    'ساختار پایگاه دانش و ثبت پرسش‌های عمومی، خدماتی و قیمتی ایجاد شد.' AS message;

## فقط یک‌بار اجرا شود

این Workflow پایگاه دانش کلینیک و جدول ثبت پرسش‌ها را ایجاد می‌کند.

دسته‌ها شامل اطلاعات عمومی، ساعات کاری، آدرس، خدمات، قیمت، بیمه، آمادگی قبل از مراجعه و قوانین کلینیک است.

سؤالات بدون پاسخ یا نیازمند تأیید انسانی می‌توانند وارد صف منشی شوند.
